correctness.rationale: The exact distance-count formulas imply that outside a-vertices are distinguished only by whether their b-mates are selected, so there are at most two; symmetrically there are at most two outside b-vertices. A six-vertex complement would force both spine vertices outside and A=B=r-2, making their multiset signatures identical. The explicit five-vertex complement proves sharpness. Equality forces exactly the two complement patterns stated, and direct signature tables prove validity for all claimed r. The verifier independently checks every smaller set and every minimum-size set for r=3..9.
